title: Our Impact In Numbers | Saylani Welfare
text: Saylani Welfare International Trust's official website reports the following current impact figures (as displayed on the homepage, updated periodically): more than 450,000 underprivileged people served daily across 1,138+ areas in Pakistan; about 1,500,000 lives served every year across Pakistan; 250,000 people fed daily through Dastarkhwan and related food programs; roughly 12,000 family adoptions (Kafalat) every month; and about 400,000 students taught annually. A separate 'Our Initiatives' breakdown on the site lists people helped by program: Dastarkhwan food program - 250,000; Clean Water - 35 million (people/liters served); SBIL (Saylani School of Business and Islamic Leadership) - 4,500; Old Age Home - 90; Orphanage - 300; Vocational Training - 3,000; SMIT (Saylani Mass IT Training) - 200,000; Mother & Child care - 11,900. The organization also states it has grown to 125+ physical branches. (Source: saylaniwelfare.com homepage, official AI/crawl-visible content.)
